title: Elephant 'small snack' meme
caption:
The daily menu of an Asian elephant is mostly... the daily menu.

Wild Asian elephants also drink about 189 litres (50 gallons) of water a day. The clips were filmed at Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage, Sri Lanka; the river shot is a wild elephant in Laos.

Source: Smithsonian's National Zoo.  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
